name: 43460 · Rossford, OH
findings: ZIP 43460 (Rossford) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43460 (Rossford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43460 (Rossford) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
